text: Acceptance proven. Finite-iteration Sinkhorn now returns generic Compare; the 3x1, epsilon=0.5, one-iteration discriminator remains forward=0.18398923412103138 versus reverse=0.22051037680323535 and compile-time rejects SymmetricCompare. Exact KL retains Divergence and returns RelativeEntropySupport on incompatible support; floored KL returns generic Compare and the floor=1.0 distinct-mass zero-separation counterexample is pinned. Validation schema v2 requires typed release or working-tree source identity plus exact detector and Engbert oracle documents. Repository SHA-256 values are 7582beb4de3650a6631362c91849cdaae6bd394dc821d0ef5fd2b394290892b7 and 923b6019cd2c1d956a4c8be701386c83a21bcfd96a926b2b61751034d2bf5271; JVM independently rehashes both files and requires validation/eyes4s-validation-0.1.0.json to equal canonical generator output exactly. Current working-tree scientific digest is b6b4e348428c88935a9c2fd2690e308f934fb9ddee01080f476303bab8281327; shared cross-platform fixture digest is a7d203bfa104687a0f6fcef278b0141e8fa1da9b0a175c81762f451a9bff2cd3. Deliberately replacing the detector digest killed three tests: file drift, pinned digest, and oracle-change sensitivity. Pre-fix discriminators failed the old law claims; restored results: compare JVM 106/106 and JS 106/106, laws JVM 225/225 and JS 222/222, scalafmtCheckAll, scalafmtSbtCheck, checkBoundaries, headerCheckAll, and git diff --check green. Release serialization uses an artifact-only follow-up whose source_revision names the already committed source/oracles, avoiding self-reference. No staging, commit, or push performed.
